title: Chapter 734 - 734 Arrival; Annihilation! (2)

Chapter 734 - 734 Arrival; Annihilation! (2)

Chapter 734 - 734 Arrival; Annihilation! (2)

734 Arrival; Annihilation! (2)

The nine Z-series golden warships were like nine suns that were advancing rapidly in the void. They were incomparably dazzling and eye-catching.

The baleful aura was oppressive, and wherever it passed, all living beings retreated.

At the center of the battleship Z001.

Zach crossed his arms and stared at the endless void with his sharp eyes.

At this moment, a message popped up from the Z001 system.

[Hint: A planet has appeared in the predetermined orbit. It is expected to collide with it in 30 minutes. Do you want to enter the alternative orbit?]]

“No!” Zach said lightly.

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his finger slightly.

“Whoosh!”

In an instant, a dazzling energy pillar shot out.

“Boom!”

A moment later, a planet in the distance exploded, turning into fireworks that filled the sky.

Dazzling and resplendent.

….

In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.

For the past half a year, other than cultivating, Lin Fan had been working hard.

His strength had been steadily improving.

On this day, Lin Fan had just finished cultivating.

A series of clear notifications suddenly sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Level 1 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 2 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 3 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 4 King Stage cultivator detected.]

….

[Ding! Level 1 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator detected.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his brows twitched.

Emperor level expert!

Even though Lin Fan had already killed two Emperor level beings.

However, they were all curses.

Lin Fan had never even met them before.

Therefore…

Strictly speaking, this was the first time he was so close to a monarch.

Emperor level!

Lin Fan’s heart raced.

He slowly raised his head and looked into the void with his pair of Heavenly Eyes.

But soon, Lin Fan’s face turned weird.

Because, in his vision, everyone was filled with countless weaknesses, including the strongest among them.

Emperor-ranked?

Just this?

Lin Fan shook his head slightly. Stepping out, he disappeared from where he was.

….

At this moment, nine golden warships were floating in the air in a fan-shaped formation.

In the Z001 golden warship.

Zach’s sharp eyes swept over the Earth in front of him.

Invisible, it formed a gust of wind in the void that was like a calm lake, quickly rippling in all directions.

“Buzz!”

Before the strong wind reached Earth, it was completely blocked by a transparent energy barrier and did not affect Earth at all.

Zach raised his eyebrows.”

His eyes shone with golden light, as if there was a giant dragon circling around him, staring at the earth.

“A small planet actually has such dense spiritual energy! There were some secrets. Perhaps, he should go in and investigate.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his hand and condensed an energy light spot.

The light spot quickly grew larger, and in an instant, it became the size of a football, the size of a pot lid…In the end, it became the size of a football field.

“Whoosh!”

Then, the energy ball the size of a football field flew toward Earth at high speed.

In Zach’s eyes, the protective shield on the surface of the earth would shatter like a bubble in the next moment.

Perhaps, more than half of the entire Earth would be destroyed, or even completely destroyed.

Zach didn’t care about this at all.

However, the next moment, Zach’s eyes narrowed slightly.

That was because, just as the energy ball was about to reach Earth, a figure suddenly appeared in front of it.

It was Lin Fan!

He saw…Lin Fan raised his hand slowly.

” Universe in a Palm!”

A huge palm phantom appeared in the air, surrounded by starlight, dazzling and eye-catching.

When the energy ball came into contact with his palm, it was like a drop of water merging into the sea. It did not set off any waves and disappeared in an instant.

“Hmm?”

In the Z001 golden warship, Zach raised his eyebrows and a touch of surprise appeared on his face.

With a flash, he appeared in the void.

Zach stared at Lin Fan with his sharp eyes and said,””You’re the one who destroyed the Z010 warship, right? I don’t think I have any information on you. Who are you? What is your position in the Four Seasons Universe?”

He stood with his hands behind his back and looked down at Lin Fan.

It exuded the contempt of an expert.

Lin Fan said,” Who are you?”

Lin Fan could already tell from the Eye of Heaven that Zach and the rest could be killed with a flip of his hand.

Therefore, he was not in a hurry.

Using this opportunity to ask about the situation in the ocean universe was also a good thing.

After all, after killing them, the ocean universe might send even stronger people.

Only by knowing yourself and your enemy can you win every battle.

” I’m Heavenly King Zach of the ocean universe,” Zach said proudly.” I’m the special marshal of the ocean universe master!””

Lin Fan nodded his head,” Can your strength in the ocean universe be ranked in the top 10?””

“Are you trying to find out about the strength of my ocean universe? How ridiculous! You’d better be a muddle-headed ghost!” Zach shouted.

As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly swung his saber.

The mighty saber energy seemed to have split the entire universe.

The reason why Zach was chatting with Lin Fan was to prepare this killer move.

He wanted to destroy Lin Fan and Earth.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed earlier was simply too shocking and terrifying.

Even Zach felt that it would be a tough battle.

There was even a possibility of capsizing.

Zach, on the other hand, liked to kill all possibilities in the cradle.

The mighty blade energy shone brightly on Lin Fan’s face.

However, Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all.

He shook his head slightly and said,”Why are you in such a hurry to attack?””

As soon as he finished speaking, a majestic Transcendence Golden Body suddenly appeared behind Lin Fan.

The Transcendence Golden Body instantly merged into his body.

“Whoosh!”

Instantly, Lin Fan’s entire body shone with a dazzling golden light.

The golden light gathered crazily towards his fist, forming a huge golden fist shadow in the air.

He threw a punch.

A terrifying power surged out like a tsunami.

“Boom!”

The mighty saber energy shattered like a bubble.

Zach’s pupils constricted, and his entire face turned pale. He cried out in horror,”Impossible!”

This was his last voice.

As for Z001, Z002, Z003…The people in the battleship did not even make a sound. They only made a stunned expression.

“Boom!”

Fist shadows covered the area.

Zach, Z001, Z002, Z003, and the rest of the battleships, as well as everyone on the battleships, all turned into nothingness, completely disappearing from this world.

After a long time, the fist shadow slowly disappeared. What replaced it was a huge black hole in the void.

At this moment, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Killed King Stage Level 1 cultivator. Obtained 1 billion experience points.]

[Ding! Killed King Stage Level 2 cultivator. Obtained 2 billion experience points.]

[Ding! Killed a King Stage Level 3 cultivator. Obtained 3 billion experience points.]

….

[Ding! Killed a Level 1 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator. Obtained 10 billion experience points.]
